<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914390_theRebbe_977" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914390_theRebbe_977__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section distinguishes between the Zohar's discussion of teshuvah as drawing down the determination of the hidden and absolute will, and the maamar "Shir HaMaalos" which discusses drawing down the absolute will itself from the essence of the Ein Sof.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that in the maamar of the Zohar, "and that deep depth is called Teshuvah,"</t>
    <t s="2">it speaks about the matter of teshuvah—the drawing down of the determination of the hidden will and the absolute will, whereby through arousal from below the revealed will is aroused,</t>
    <t s="3">which comes about through the teshuvah of Rosh HaShanah and the Ten Days of Repentance.</t>
    <t s="4">And since the determination of the hidden will and the absolute will is in relation to the revealed will,</t>
    <t s="5">therefore,</t>
    <t s="6">also the service through which the drawing down of the determination occurs is on the level of the essence of the soul that is related to the revealed faculties,</t>
    <t s="7">which, in general, are the encompassing lights of Chayah and Yechidah.</t>
    <t s="8">And in the maamar "Shir HaMaalos Stam" etc.</t>
    <t s="9">(which does not mention the matter of teshuvah there)</t>
    <t s="10">it speaks about the matter of drawing down the absolute will itself</t>
    <t s="11">(the inwardness and essence of Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="12">the root of all roots),</t>
    <t s="13">for this drawing down is through the service that stems from the essence of the soul</t>
    <t s="14">(the inwardness and essence of the soul).</t>
    <t s="15">And this is why in this maamar</t>
    <t s="16">(specifically)</t>
    <t s="17">it says "Shir HaMaalos Stam" etc., that all inhabitants of the world are destined to say it,</t>
    <t s="18">because the service that stems from the essence of the soul is equal in all of them.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the service of "from the depths" on Rosh HaShanah and Yom Kippur is from a higher depth of the soul's essence than during the intermediate days of repentance.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="2">that on Rosh HaShanah and Yom Kippur, the service of "from the depths" is more elevated than the service of "from the depths" during the days between Rosh HaShanah and Yom Kippur.</t>
    <t s="3">For during the Ten Days of Repentance,</t>
    <t s="4">whose theme is</t>
    <t s="5">(as their name indicates)</t>
    <t s="6">days of teshuvah</t>
    <t s="7">(and the matter of "make Me king over you" is not so revealed during these days),</t>
    <t s="8">the service of "from the depths"</t>
    <t s="9">(which is revealed)</t>
    <t s="10">is</t>
    <t s="11">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="12">in the depth of the essence of the soul that is related to the revealed faculties,</t>
    <t s="13">but on Rosh HaShanah, whose main theme is "make Me king over you"</t>
    <t s="14">[for this matter is primarily from the aspect of the essence of the soul],</t>
    <t s="15">the service of "from the depths" is in the depth of the essence of the soul that is above relation to the revealed faculties.</t>
    <t s="16">And likewise on Yom Kippur,</t>
    <t s="17">for since its main theme is the atonement that comes from the essence of the day itself,</t>
    <t s="18">the revelation of the essential bond of the essence of the soul with the Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="19">therefore,</t>
    <t s="20">also the service of Yom Kippur is from the aspect of the depth of the essence of the soul that is above relation to the revealed faculties.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the teshuvah of Yom Kippur stems from the soul's essence above relation to the revealed faculties, making it equal for all, unlike the graded teshuvah of other days.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that the service from the aspect of the depth of the essence of the soul on Yom Kippur is in the teshuvah of Yom Kippur,</t>
    <t s="2">which is more elevated than the teshuvah of all the days of the year and even than the teshuvah of the Ten Days of Repentance39.</t>
    <t s="3">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="4">that in teshuvah in general,</t>
    <t s="5">the essential bond of the essence of the soul with the Atzmus is only the cause that brings about teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="6">but the teshuvah itself</t>
    <t s="7">[whose theme is regret for having done contrary to the will and acceptance to fulfill His will, blessed be He]</t>
    <t s="8">is from the aspect of the essence of the soul that is related to the revealed faculties, which reaches the Master of the Will,</t>
    <t s="9">but the teshuvah of Yom Kippur is</t>
    <t s="10">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="11">to be bonded with the Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="12">and therefore there is felt in it a revelation of the bond of the essence of the soul</t>
    <t s="13">(which is above relation to the revealed faculties)</t>
    <t s="14">with the Atzmus</t>
    <t s="15">(which is above the Master of the Will)40.</t>
    <t s="16">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="17">that this is what the Rambam41 said,</t>
    <t s="18">that Yom Kippur is a time of teshuvah for all,</t>
    <t s="19">that the intention of "for all" is</t>
    <t s="20">(also)</t>
    <t s="21">for all equally.</t>
    <t s="22">For in the teshuvah of all the days of the year</t>
    <t s="23">(including also the teshuvah of the Ten Days of Repentance)</t>
    <t s="24">which is from the level of the essence of the soul that is related to the revealed faculties,</t>
    <t s="25">there are many distinctions of levels.</t>
    <t s="26">But the teshuvah of Yom Kippur, which is from the aspect of the essence of the soul that is above relation to the revealed faculties,</t>
    <t s="27">is equal in all of them.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
